I don't know of an Ollama environment variable named `OLLAMA_UNLOAD_TIMEOUT`, so I can't give a default for it. It may not exist, or it may have been added after what I know.

The closest setting I do know is `OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE`, which controls how long a model stays loaded in memory after a request. Its default is `5m` (5 minutes). The per-request `keep_alive` parameter overrides it.

If you saw `OLLAMA_UNLOAD_TIMEOUT` somewhere specific, such as a doc, a fork, or a wrapper tool, tell me where and I can help work out what it does. You can also run `ollama serve --help` or check the `envconfig` source in the Ollama repo to see which variables your version supports.
